dashboard_item.raw_yaml:
title: Detect suspicious cmd.exe spawning tasklist.exe
id: 1d819a6e-b586-49db-aa31-b8d22acc970a
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious execution of tasklist.exe spawned by cmd.exe, which
  is a common indicator of potential command-line shell abuse.
references: https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1087/
author: SigmaGen
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: \tasklist.exe
    ParentImage|endswith: \cmd.exe
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative tasks
level: medium
dashboard_item.wazuh_xml:

    <field name="win.eventdata.parentImage" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+cmd\.exe$</field>
    <description>Detect suspicious cmd.exe spawning tasklist.exe [Alert: AI-20261012_133213.227-6077db78b13e]</description>
    <mitre>
      <id>T1087</id>
    </mitre>
  </rule>
</group>
